translation: Write R for the binary atom symbol indexed by 0 and xᵢ for the variable indexed by i. Def15 takes natural numbers a and b, in that order, and returns the formula R(xₐ, xᵦ). Def16 is the formula ∀x₀ (K(¬R(x₀, x₀)) ↔ R(x₁, x₀)). The quantifier binds x₀ on both sides of the biconditional; x₁ is free. Def17 is the formula ¬R(x₁, x₁), with both occurrences of x₁ free. These are definitions of formulas, with no hypotheses or assertions of truth or derivability.
